profile.headline: Software Engineer at Coinbase
profile.summary:
Software engineer specializing in Python, Go, and TypeScript. I build backends and data platforms across fintech, logistics, utilities, and the public sector: fraud detection, document automation, data lakes, and contact center platforms that route and automate customer interactions at scale. I work end to end, designing the service, choosing the infrastructure, and running it in production.
Two things shape how I work: I care about the business outcome behind the ticket, and I use AI aggressively as an engineering multiplier. AWS Solutions Architect (Associate) and Data Analytics (Specialty) certified.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Contract via ScaleCapacity
- Implemented multiple Golang microservices and gRPC APIs to extend backend functionality for Amazon Connect, Salesforce, and internal platforms—improving customer experience through tighter system integration.

positions.title: Associate Data Engineer
positions.insights: Amazon Connect, Amazon Redshift and +14 skills

positions.title: Research Assistant Programmer
positions.description:
Developed web scrapers using Python for data extraction to assist research focused on public data in the US
Deployed crawlers in with a combination of Amazon Lambda and EC2
Created and maintained RDS SQL Server to easily store and access scraped data

positions.title: Instructional Student Assistant
positions.description:
Provided instructional support for two mega online courses with over 80 students in each class
Tutored students on business intelligence topics such as big data and information systems infrastructure
Helped trained students to use Microsoft Excel and Access
positions.insights: Data Analysis, Data Modeling and +3 skills

positions.title: Student Data Analyst
positions.description:
Managed, optimized and improved project management system resulting in 60% less overdue tasks and projects and increased productivity between clients and employees
Collaborated with a team to analyze construction bids to meet franchise contract requirements and budgeting
Assisted in transitioning convenience store data from a MICROS database to Clover’s Point of Sale System
Utilized Excel and Tableau to report analysis on sale/financial reports to upper management

certifications.name: Amazon Web Services Data Analytics Specialty
certifications.title: Amazon Web Services Data Analytics Specialty

projects.title: Boeing Analytics Project - Image Classification
projects.description:
Worked with a team to develop, model, and train an image classification model with 92%  accuracy on various different plane parts.
Collaborated with a separate app development team to create an augmented reality mobile app that utilizes the image classification model
Utilized Amazon Sagemaker, Amazon EMR, and PyTorch

projects.title: Predicting “No-Shows” using Clinical Data, Data Mining Project
projects.description:
Final Project for CIS 4321 (Data Mining)
- Applied data mining techniques to create a model that predicts a patient’s attendance to their scheduled appointment based on clinical data sourced from Brazil
- Used data mining process: data preprocessing, exploratory and descriptive analysis, visualization and model building and evaluation.
